items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don't think he played with Trini... [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: I don't think he played with Trini, he played with the little band that you had in Cleveland; he never played with Trini, I don't think.
I asked Pillars the same thing and he said no, he never played with him, he played with the band, the seven piece band at the Majestic and all over the place.
